description:
A logged fuel entry can only be deleted and re-added (FuelPanel.tsx:224-232; apps/api/src/routes/fuel.ts:102-110 offers DELETE and no PATCH). Misjudging a portion — the single most common tracking error — costs a delete, a retype, and a lost timestamp.

Add PATCH /api/fuel/:id accepting label, proteinG, calories (same Math.max(0,...) clamping as POST, fuel.ts:87-100), scoped to the calling user. In the UI, tapping a row in "Logged today" opens it inline in the same NumberField form the custom-add already uses (FuelPanel.tsx:246-283).

This is the "every write visible, every number honest" contract from the trust phase applied to fuel: right now the only way to correct a number is to destroy the record of it.
title: Edit a logged fuel entry instead of deleting and retyping it
